question: What difference exists between higher and lower tattvas?
premises: thus form exists for water and so forth up to Sakti-tattva abode
inference: Higher tattva is Sakti itself, while lower is its quality; that is the difference.
plain_english: Thus for water and so forth up to Sakti-tattva abode form exists such; but higher is Sakti-tattva, lower is its quality, difference.
